title: Site Settings

fields.label: Header & Navigation
fields.instructions: Mega menu preview cards and the scrolling ticker bar — both rendered in header.php, sitewide.

fields.label: Mega Menu Previews
fields.name: mega_menu_previews
fields.instructions: One row per top-level nav item, in the same order — eyebrow/headline/description shown in the mega menu's right-hand preview panel when that item is focused/hovered.

fields.label: Ticker Messages
fields.name: ticker_messages
fields.instructions: Only the first row's text is currently shown (header.php) — the ticker no longer rotates/auto-advances (2026-08-05 change).

fields.label: Hero Slides
fields.name: hero_slides
fields.instructions: Mega-hero headline/sub slideshow. First entry with isPartnership=1 renders as a co-branding lockup instead of plain text.

fields.label: Trust & Stats (homepage)
fields.instructions: template-parts/home/trust-credibility.php — heading, the client-logo row (pick which `client` posts show, or leave empty for the first 6 alphabetically), and the 4 stat cards.

fields.label: Trust section eyebrow
fields.name: trust_section_eyebrow
fields.instructions: Unused — the reference design this section was rebuilt to match (2026-08-21, pass 3) has no eyebrow badge, so template-parts/home/trust-credibility.php never reads this field. Kept registered rather than deleted (no data-loss risk if something was saved here), but filling it in has no visible effect.

fields.label: Client logos shown
fields.name: trust_logo_clients
fields.instructions: Pick which Clients appear in the logo row, and drag to set their order. Leave empty to fall back to the first 6 Clients alphabetically. Each Client shows its uploaded `logo` image if it has one, otherwise its name as a monochrome text wordmark. Picking more than 6 makes the row cross-fade through them, 6 at a time.

fields.label: Trust metrics
fields.name: trust_metrics
fields.instructions: As many as you like — the grid shows 4 at a time; if you add more than 4, they auto-rotate on the live page (cross-fade, ~5s) instead of all cramming into one grid.

fields.label: Video showcase (homepage)
fields.instructions: 2026-08-24: full-bleed video-showcase section (template-parts/home/video-showcase.php), placed right after the Trust & Stats section on the homepage. One video (or, if none uploaded yet, just the poster photo) serves double duty — muted/looping as the section's own background, and the same file plays with sound + controls in the “Play video” lightbox, so there's only one asset to source/upload, not two.

fields.label: Show video showcase
fields.name: show_video_showcase
fields.instructions: 2026-09-01: this section's homepage slot was taken by the scroll-driven "door reveal" section (template-parts/home/hero-door-reveal.php). The Video Showcase itself is untouched — markup, fields and the uploaded video all still here — just switched off by default, exactly like the Traffic Demo toggle further down. Turn this on to bring it back; it renders directly below the door reveal.

fields.label: Background/poster photo
fields.name: video_showcase_poster
fields.instructions: Full-bleed cover image. Also used as the <video> poster frame when a video is set below. Leave empty to show an honest placeholder instead of stock footage.

fields.label: Video
fields.name: video_showcase_video
fields.instructions: Optional. When set: plays muted/looped as the section's own moving background, AND is what “Play video” opens in the lightbox (unmuted, with controls). Leave empty to use the poster photo alone as a static background — the “Play video” button only renders at all if this is set, since there'd be nothing to play otherwise.

fields.label: Why Choose Photos
fields.name: why_choose_photos
fields.instructions: Pill-tab split panel — one tab per row. Real fallback content lives in template-parts/home/why-choose.php, kept in sync with this field's own default rows.

fields.label: Real Use Cases carousel (homepage)
fields.instructions: Just the section heading — the cards themselves come from Products (Products → a product's own "Real Use Cases Card" tab), not from here.

fields.label: Use cases teaser heading
fields.name: use_cases_teaser_heading
fields.instructions: Just the section heading — the cards themselves come from Products (Products → a product's own “Real Use Cases Card” tab), not from here.

fields.label: One integrated platform (homepage)
fields.instructions: 2026-08-06 (wp-admin content audit): homepage section directly below the mega-hero's teaser image (template-parts/home/integrated-platform.php) — headline/body/CTA label were hardcoded, moved here. Teaser image moved into this tab 2026-08-24 (was a separate, disconnected field at the top of this page) — same section, now grouped together.

fields.label: Body
fields.name: integrated_platform_body
fields.default_value: Control analytics, access control and patrol from a single cloud-based console.

fields.label: "Learn more" button label
fields.name: integrated_platform_cta_label
fields.instructions: Opens the platform demo modal (template-parts/platform-demo-modal.php) — not a link, so there's no URL field here.

fields.label: 404 page
fields.instructions: 2026-08-06 (wp-admin content audit): 404.php's heading, description and 2 button labels were hardcoded, moved here. The 2 buttons' destinations (home / contact) are structural navigation, not copy, and stay in the template.

fields.label: Legacy (unused)
fields.instructions: Fields no current template reads. Kept registered rather than deleted in case something was saved here historically.

fields.label: Proof stats
fields.name: proof_stats
fields.instructions: Unused — the standalone "PROOF" stat-tiles section this fed was cut in the 2026-08-05 homepage consolidation pass; its 2 real numbers were moved directly into the Trust & Stats tab's Trust metrics instead. No template reads this field any more. Kept registered rather than deleted (no data-loss risk if something was saved here).

fields.label: Portfolio page
fields.name: portfolio_page_tab
fields.instructions: The /portfolio/ client-directory page (page-portfolio.php).

fields.label: Enable /portfolio/ page
fields.name: enable_portfolio_page
fields.instructions: 2026-08-26: disabled per explicit instruction, kept as a real toggle (same pattern as "Show traffic demo" below) rather than deleted outright, so it can be switched back on later with no code change. When off, visiting /portfolio/ redirects straight to the homepage (page-portfolio.php) — the page's actual content/markup is untouched either way. The Portfolio sub-section on each Industry long-form page (single-industry.php, client spotlight + logo rows) is separate and NOT affected by this toggle.

description: PROJECT.md §4 Options Page “Site Settings”. Values populated from §6 (do-not-invent list) — pulled into templates so they're editable in one place, never hardcoded. Reconstructed 2026-08-24 after an accidental JSON-file deletion (see NOTES.md-equivalent commit note) — field names/types verified against real saved wp_options rows and each consuming template's own field usage, not guessed. Reorganized into topic tabs 2026-08-24 (was a 30-field flat list at the top before the 4 existing tabs) — explicit instruction, for admin discoverability.
